entities.name: TEGNA
entities.control_summary: Wholly owned subsidiary of Nexstar after the March 2026 close. A hold-separate order from the Eastern District of California (17 Apr 2026) requires TEGNA to keep operating as an independently managed unit while the states' antitrust case proceeds.
entities.notes: TGNA was delisted. Closed is not combined operations.

entities.name: TEGNA local stations
entities.control_summary: Group node for TEGNA newsrooms. Legal parent is Nexstar. Hold-separate keeps the newsrooms operationally distinct for now.
entities.notes: 64 stations / 51 markets on TEGNA IR as of Aug 2026. Not every call sign is listed.

entities.name: WUSA (CBS 9 Washington)
entities.control_summary: TEGNA's Washington CBS affiliate. Same Nexstar parent and hold-separate as the rest of the group.

entities.name: KPNX (12 News Phoenix)
entities.control_summary: TEGNA's Phoenix NBC affiliate.

entities.name: Gray Media
entities.control_summary: Dual-class. The Howell / Robinson family holds a controlling combined vote through Class A. Renamed from Gray Television on 1 Jan 2025.
entities.notes: 117 full-power markets; ~37% of U.S. TV households as of May 2026.

entities.name: Howell family
entities.control_summary: Hilton H. Howell Jr., Robin R. Howell, and Harriett J. Robinson. Together they beneficially own more than 48.5% of combined voting power of Gray common and Class A.
entities.notes: Howell Jr. and Robin each reported 27.4% combined vote as of 6 Mar 2026; Robinson 26.7%. Overlap is family attribution, not three independent blocs.

entities.name: Hilton H. Howell Jr.
entities.control_summary: Chairman and CEO of Gray Media. Largest named slice of the family Class A block.

entities.name: Gray local stations
entities.control_summary: Group node for Gray-operated local TV newsrooms. Voting control sits with the Howell family.
entities.notes: Not every call sign is listed.

entities.name: Cox Media Group
entities.control_summary: CMG Media Corporation. Apollo holds the controlling stake (~71%). Cox Enterprises keeps a minority (~29%). Not the same company as Cox Communications, which Charter closed on in August 2026.
entities.notes: Apollo has shopped the group. A sale is not closed.

entities.name: Apollo Global Management
entities.control_summary: Private-equity controller of Cox Media Group. Not a 13F index holder and not a newsroom editor.
entities.notes: Do not recurse into who owns Apollo funds.

entities.name: Cox Enterprises
entities.control_summary: Cox family company. Minority stake in Cox Media Group. Still owns The Atlanta Journal-Constitution. Cable arm sold to Charter in August 2026.

entities.name: Cox family
entities.control_summary: Beneficial owners of Cox Enterprises.
entities.notes: Minority in CMG. Not the controller of WSB-TV.

entities.name: Cox local stations
entities.control_summary: Group node for CMG television newsrooms. Apollo is the controller; Cox is the minority.
entities.notes: Not every call sign is listed.

entities.name: WSB-TV (Channel 2 Atlanta)
entities.control_summary: Cox Media Group's Atlanta ABC affiliate. Apollo control, Cox minority.

entities.name: iHeartMedia
entities.control_summary: Largest U.S. radio group. Public. No family dual-class lock. Large holders include PIMCO and Global Media & Entertainment Investments (capped, non-controlling).
entities.notes: 860+ stations in ~160 markets as of Dec 2025.

entities.name: Robert Pittman
entities.control_summary: Chairman and CEO of iHeartMedia. Hired executive, not a dual-class controller.

entities.name: iHeart local stations
entities.control_summary: Group node for iHeart radio newsrooms. Public parent, no family controller.
entities.notes: Not every call sign is listed.

entities.name: Premiere Networks
entities.control_summary: iHeart's national radio syndication arm.

entities.name: Nant Capital
entities.control_summary: Patrick Soon-Shiong's private vehicle. Holds the Los Angeles Times and the San Diego Union-Tribune through NantMedia / California Times.

entities.name: California Times
entities.control_summary: Nant publishing unit for the LA Times titles.

entities.name: Patrick Soon-Shiong
entities.control_summary: Sole controlling owner of Nant Capital and the Los Angeles Times.

entities.name: Los Angeles Times
entities.control_summary: Privately owned. Patrick Soon-Shiong via Nant Capital.

entities.name: The San Diego Union-Tribune
entities.control_summary: Same Nant / Soon-Shiong control as the Los Angeles Times.
